items.title: The Hand-Penned Birthday Letter
items.subtitle: A heartfelt birthday note written straight from the heart on gold parchment

payload.letterTitle: To My Partner in Crime & Best Friend Ever
payload.letterContent:
Dear Bestie,

Happy, happy 25th Birthday! 🎉

I couldn't let today pass without putting together a special little digital world just for you. From our random late-night drives to all the moments we laughed so hard we couldn't breathe, you've made every year brighter, funnier, and full of adventure.

Thank you for always being the most genuine, dependable, and wildly entertaining friend anyone could ever ask for. Here is to celebrating you today and to all the incredible memories we haven't even made yet.

Enjoy every single second of your day — you deserve the entire world!

Always your best friend,
Your Friend ❤️

items.subtitle: A final toast nestled at the very bottom of this keepsake chest

payload.lastNoteTitle: A Birthday Toast to Our Next 50 Years 📜
payload.lastNoteParchment:
And so, as you reach the bottom of this little hamper universe, know that having a friend like you is a once-in-a-lifetime blessing.

May this year bring you endless good health, unstoppable success, and unforgettable moments.

Now go blow out those candles and eat some cake! 🎂✨
